verdict.rationale: MX documents a ready-made, embeddable Connect Widget that prompts end users to connect to their financial institutions, with Web and React Native SDKs, so developers don't build institution UI themselves. The pack does not show the server-side session/URL creation step or what identifier comes back for the connected account; Tokenized Account Numbers are an ACH payment feature, not a connection handle. Missing for 10: documented server-side widget session creation, documented return of a token/identifier for the connected account on completion, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let a user connect their bank with a drop-in hosted flow — create a session server-side, open the widget, and get back a token for the connected account — without building institution UI myself

citations.quote: MX's ready-made UI that can be embedded in your application to aggregate users' account data by prompting end users to connect to their financial institutions using their credentials
Use the Connect Widget and Platform API to let end users connect to their accounts.
Embed the Connect Widget into your web application using the Web SDK.
Embed the Connect Widget into your react native app using the React Native SDK.
